description: The episodes a given edition references (title + show + published date + episode ids) — the cheapest way to map a week. Omitting ``slug`` returns the latest edition's episodes. Pass ``region`` for a region's reading list (the regional pilot, same as the site's ?region=); the payload's ``regions`` lists what the edition offers.

lang.description: Localized row titles (es / zh) when the translations exist; omit for English

region.description: Regional reading list (na / emea / apac / latam); omit for the global edition

slug.description: YYYY-MM-DD edition date (from list_digests); omit for the latest

name: list_digest_episodes

lang.description: The requested language (titles best-effort per row)

region.description: The applied regional view ('' = the global edition)

region_note.description: Set when a requested region filter emptied the view

title: List an edition's episodes
